title: Designing Compact Neural Architectures via Neuron Gating and Mixed Activation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14443v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) is naturally formulated as a bilevel optimization problem, where the upper-level optimizes the architecture using validation performance and the lower-level trains network parameters using training loss. However, NAS is computationally expensive due to discrete architectural decisions, exponentially growing search spaces, and the high cost of training candidate architectures. This work develops a general bilevel optimization framework for NAS across diverse architectures, including MLPs, CNNs, RNNs, and Transformers, to identify compact architectures with strong predictive performance. We propose three scalable formulations that replace discrete neuron- and activation-level decisions with continuous relaxations, enabling differentiable optimization over otherwise combinatorial architecture spaces. translated_title: 通过神经元门控与混合激活设计紧凑神经网络架构
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14443v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：神经架构搜索（NAS）自然被表述为一个双层优化问题，其中上层使用验证性能优化架构，下层使用训练损失训练网络参数。然而，由于离散的架构决策、指数级增长的搜索空间以及训练候选架构的高成本，NAS在计算上非常昂贵。本研究开发了一个通用的双层优化框架，适用于包括MLP、CNN、RNN和Transformer在内的多种架构，以识别具有强大预测性能的紧凑架构。我们提出了三种可扩展的公式，将离散的神经元级和激活级决策替换为连续松弛，从而实现对原本组合性的架构空间进行可微优化。这些公式产生了三种NAS方法：基于神经元门控的NAS（NAS-NG）、基于混合激活的NAS（NAS-MA）等。
tldr: 本文提出了一种通用双层优化框架，通过连续松弛和三种可扩展方法（如神经元门控与混合激活）在多种架构中高效搜索紧凑且高性能的神经网络。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a general bilevel optimization framework with continuous relaxations and three scalable methods (e.g., neuron gating and mixed activation) to efficiently search for compact and high-performance neural networks across diverse architectures.
